title: Electrocardiogram machine learning for detection of cardiovascular disease in African Americans: the Jackson Heart Study.
summary: ECG/VCG machine learning detected prevalent cardiovascular disease in the Jackson Heart Study cohort; the modest result is limited to cross-sectional risk detection. The paper appeared in European Heart Journal - Digital Health.
ai_technology: Random forest, convolutional neural network and regression models

evidence.tested: ECG/VCG machine learning detected prevalent cardiovascular disease in the Jackson Heart Study cohort; the modest result is limited to cross-sectional risk detection.
